purpose: Teach: 隣り/変っ/ぶらぶら/思い立っ/すかさず/たどり着く/不意/あからさま

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはお隣り町に住んでるのよ
lines.en: Sho, I actually live in the town next door.
lines.style: Warm opening, inviting him in with a small smile in her voice. Gentle clarification, no rush. She's making it easy for him to understand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、季節が変ってきたのを感じるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I can feel that the seasons are changing.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering aloud. He's noticing something quiet and real. No performance — just sharing what's in his head, trusting she'll listen.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと公園をぶらぶら散歩しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, why don't we take a walk together through the park?
lines.style: Light invitation in her tone. Unhurried, like she's suggesting something small and good. The kind of quiet warmth that makes a child feel included without fussing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、急に思い立ってお祖父ちゃんに電話したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I suddenly felt like calling Grandpa, so I did.
lines.style: Small proud note underneath. He's telling her something he did on his own. Not boasting — just quietly pleased he thought of it, checking that she's impressed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、すかさずママに見せに行きましょう
lines.en: Sho, let's go show your mom right away.
lines.style: Quick, practical warmth. She's caught his energy and moving with it. A light prompt forward — no hesitation, just gentle momentum.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんのお家にたどり着くまで歩いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I walked all the way to Grandpa's house.
lines.style: Pride breaking through more openly now. He's telling her about a small but real achievement. His voice lifts slightly — he wants her to know he did this.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、不意のプレゼントは嬉しいわね
lines.en: Sho, unexpected gifts are the best kind, aren't they?
lines.style: Soft recognition in her voice. She's seen what his visit meant. Tender but not sentimental — just acknowledging something true, warmly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの喜びがあからさまに分かったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I could tell exactly how happy Grandpa was.
lines.style: Voice full of something satisfied and real. He noticed it, he knows it mattered, and he's letting her see that he understands the weight of that. Genuine close.
